decisions.reason: As a core safety shoe line closely aligned with the firm’s main business, it is worth retaining while market acceptance continues to become clearer.
A comfort insole is relatively cheap to keep on offer and extends the footwear system, so the option value of waiting for demand feedback still outweighs the carrying cost.
This supportive insole remains close to the core range and likely inexpensive to maintain, though some overlap with other insole options raises the chance of later portfolio pruning.
Its dedicated page suggests strategic emphasis, and an ergonomic safety shoe series fits the firm’s innovation-led positioning well enough to justify continued commitment.
Firefighter and rescue boots are more specialized and likely costlier to support, but they are still a credible adjacent option in protective footwear and it is early to abandon them.
Being featured on the home page indicates strong initial commercial importance, and a moulded insole is a low-cost complementary offer that should stay while uncertainty resolves.
